description: In every nonempty ambient structure, existential self-equality is true but its actual translation through the false-domain datum is false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InterpretingTheories.empty_domain_counterexample.{u, v, w} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [K.Structure M] [Nonempty M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.existsSelfEqual FirstOrder.Language.empty ∧
    ¬M ⊨
        Lemmatheca.Entry.InterpretingTheories.emptyDomain.translateSentence
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.existsSelfEqual FirstOrder.Language.empty)
